teacher_reporting_rules.intended_definition: Natural, idiomatic English expressing the student's probable meaning; never a literal Spanish-to-English calque.
teacher_reporting_rules.uncertain_intent_rule: If natural intended meaning cannot be inferred confidently, omit it and mark intent uncertain.
teacher_reporting_rules.final_report_rule: Do not reproduce sentence-level intended corrections for pronunciation-acceptable items. Show heard -> intended only when needed to explain a supported pronunciation error or an uncertain pronunciation case.

notes: Stage-2 evidence is accepted for rubric use.
The model-generated sentence-level intended rewrites in the raw Stage-2 artifact are not approved as corrections and must not appear in the final report/PDF.
Grammar, vocabulary, fluency, interaction, and pronunciation evidence remain usable as evidence, subject to teacher review.
